commits.messageBody:
Successful insertion transfers the new entry to the manifest. Delete only
duplicate candidates: stored entries were previously deleted immediately,
and the recording path also deleted successful insertions and double-deleted
duplicates. Normal shutdown then freed dangling string storage.

The actual Debug-x64 client's first close failure symbolized to
FileManifest::remove -> FileManifestEntry::~FileManifestEntry ->
MemoryManager::free. With this repair, the product client reached login,
produced audio on an observed private sink and exited with code 0 after
the normal Debug warning-count dialog was acknowledged.

VS2013 sharedFile builds passed for Debug-x64 and Release-Win32; the
development game relink passed. Six existing x64 narrowing warnings remain.
Runtime was GE-Proton11-7 with original assets and original x86 Miles.
The headless compositor crashed after the game exited; this is not a clean
whole-harness pass or native Windows/gameplay/fidelity acceptance.
commits.messageHeadline: file: retain manifest entries until removal
